title: Chronology, mound-building and environment at Huaca Prieta, coastal Peru, from 13 700 to 4000 years ago
version: Antiquity 86(331), pp. 48–70, DOI 10.1017/S0003598X00062451. Version-of-record copy hosted by coauthor Tiffiny Tung.
lineage: Original excavation chronology. Splitstoser and Dillehay also published the separate laboratory indigo analysis, which uses this chronology but samples a different textile from the independently dated yarn.

passages.locator: p. 56, Table 1, HP-3, AA82121 and AA86948
passages.note: The cotton-yarn sample AA82121 in the upper part of stratum 52 was directly dated and reported at 6882–6657 cal BP (95%). AA86948 is charcoal from stratum 35, 5848–5585 cal BP (95%).
